desc: Parse the input to get $N, M$ and the list of operations.
Collect all unique points $L_i$ and $R_i+1$, sort them, and form elementary intervals $[p_k, p_{k+1}-1]$.
Precompute `suffix_max_R[i]` = max $R$ for operations with $L \ge i$.
Initialize DSU where `parent[i]` points to the next uncovered position $\ge i$.
Use a Max-Heap to store active Type 1 operations (keyed by $R$).
Iterate $m$ from 1 to $N$ (jumping via DSU to next uncovered).
Type 1: Best active operation in heap (covers up to its $R$).
Type 2 (Past): Operations with $R < m$ cover $[m, N]$.
Type 2 (Future): Operations with $L > m$ cover $[R_{max}+1, N]$ where $R_{max}$ is the max $R$ among them.
Select the candidate that extends coverage furthest to the right.
